info.title: ZionFood API
info.description: API v1. Token abilities supplement tenant and location authorization. Browser session mutations require CSRF tokens. Money is integer minor units. Romanian is the default human-message language; explicit Accept-Language ro/en is supported without translating schema keys or enum values. Webhook operations require a verified owner/manager browser session. Migration Center uses separate verified browser/CSRF routes documented in MIGRATION_CENTER.md. Location display settings and staff table receipts use verified browser/CSRF routes outside /api/v1; error-alert settings require platform administration. Outgoing-email ledger/provider controls are platform-admin-only browser/CSRF routes outside /api/v1; see EMAIL_DELIVERY.md. Dedicated WordPress API under /wordpress uses restaurant/location-scoped bearer credentials, explicit abilities, encrypted idempotent mutation receipts and sanitized communication journals. See WORDPRESS_API.md and WORDPRESS_CAPABILITIES.md. Payments remain placeholders.

session.name: zionfood_session
session.description: Verified browser session; mutations additionally require CSRF header

tableReceipt.description: Dining-session capability for read-only receipts, scoped to one table and session; not the QR token.

wordpress.description: Dedicated Sanctum WordPress connection token, scoped to one restaurant and explicit locations/abilities. Browser sessions and generic tokens are rejected. HTTPS mandatory outside loopback local/testing.

modifiers.description: Alternative to modifier_ids. IDs belong to category/product/selected variant. Bounds count distinct options; quantity is priced per product unit. Do not combine with non-empty modifier_ids.

postal_code.description: Required only for legacy delivery without active polygons

delivery_zone_id.description: Required for legacy postal delivery; ignored for polygon delivery

table_session_token.description: Required for dine_in; live session, unpaused table and closing cutoff checked by server

Checkout.description: Server-priced checkout. Scheduled pickup/delivery requires opt-in. Confirmed reservation_id + reservation_token permit dine_in preorder instead of a table_session_token. ISO timestamps need seconds and timezone offsets.

ingredient_ids.description: Ordered common or same-restaurant IDs. Omission preserves an existing recipe; hidden/deleted IDs may only be retained.

contains_allergens.description: Explicit product flag; the public menu also combines ingredient flags.

from_frozen.description: Explicit possible-frozen flag; the public menu also combines ingredient flags.

url.description: Public DNS HTTPS port 443, no credentials/query/fragment; redirects never followed

secret.description: Blank/null on update preserves the existing encrypted secret

url.description: Public DNS HTTPS port 443, no credentials/query/fragment; redirects never followed

DeliveryPolygon.description: Closed simple GeoJSON outer ring; coordinates longitude/latitude; no holes or self-intersections.

starts_at.description: Arrival in venue local timezone, not UTC

StaffPermissions.description: Per-organization membership capabilities, constrained by assigned locations. Owner remains full. Null legacy matrices use manager full; staff operations manage and menu view. Manage implies view. Invitations snapshot the matrix and revalidate inviter authority on acceptance.

MenuFoodContent.description: Reviewed local menu metadata, canonical version 2. AI proposals remain private until explicit approval. Nutritional estimates are clearly labelled and normalized to one portion and per 100 g. Legacy declared values remain compatible. Public responses omit analysis inputs, recipes, references and private reports.

translations.description: Persisted language maps with dish/category/menu/variant/modifier text; stale source hashes are omitted publicly.

estimated.description: True for AI estimates; clients must display an explicit estimate label.

portion_grams.description: Finished weight of one portion, when known.

per_serving.description: Same nutrient keys as values, for exactly one portion.

can_add_to_cart.description: Cart preparation permission only; can_order remains authoritative for submission regardless of the preference.

value.description: Percent: basis points (1000=10%, max10000). Fixed: currency minor units. Other kinds ignore this field.

x-webhook-events.delivery: at least once; verify timestamp and deduplicate stable event IDs

x-wordpress-credential-expiry.rotation: Previous keys receive at most 15 minutes grace, including non-expiring keys. New keys retain the connection validity choice.
x-wordpress-credential-expiry.management: Verified browser/CSRF routes documented in WORDPRESS_API.md
